decision.title: Item heap, cells and atomic items (packet )

body.p: . src/xdm_internal.h is the shared interface of the value model; later XDM packets add files, not edits.

item.p: Layout: sxml_item.representation is an internal enum (inline boolean, integer, float, double, QName; atomic, JNode, function, map, array cells; from 64 the sequence cells vector, integer range, concatenation, lazy); 0 is "no item" and, as sequence content, the empty sequence. Atomic items keep their primitive type in flags, so type families need no registry; type_or_node_index holds the annotation (node index for XNodes).

Cells: header (cell class, heap, byte count, reference count) at the start of a module's struct. A sxml_cell_class (static const) gives and, for sequence cells, count/get item/iterator next, so src/xdm.c dispatches to range, concatenation and lazy cells (1.8) without link-time dependencies. Releasing the last reference queues the cell on the heap's pending list; the outermost release frees the list in a loop, so deep values free in constant C stack (a 10^6 chain is tested). Count overflow makes a cell immortal.

Memory: every byte the heap hands out counts in live_byte_count and against maximum_byte_count: cells, side tables (sxml_item_heap_allocate_bytes), the raised error, and decimal coefficients, which go through sxml_item_heap_as_allocator (a hidden size header per block) as the heap's decimal configuration.

Decimals: a decimal cell stores its canonical text (made with the cell, not on first read), the nearest double and whether it equals it exactly. atomic-equal, the hash and compare therefore never allocate: doubles are compared through their exact decimal text, built on the stack. Numbers equal to some double hash as that double, others as their canonical text, so 1, 1.0, 1.0e0 and xs:float 1 hash alike.

Compare follows F&O 4.0 fn:compare with PR2256 (QT4 fn-compare): durations by months then seconds, binary by octets across hex and base64, QNames by namespace URI then local name. QName order needs the name pool, which sxml_atomic_comparison lacks: internal sxml_atomic_item_compare_in_heap takes the heap; the public function returns SXML_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE for distinct names (P2).

Making: strings are revalidated as UTF-8 and checked against the derived types (NCName, token, language, ...); integer subtypes by range, beyond int64_t only where the type allows (unsignedLong up to 2^64-1). sxml_atomic_item_make_taking_decimal lets operators and casting hand over a computed sxml_decimal.

Node items: sxml_item_retain/_release must retain the tree, but src/tree.c arrives with 1.11. src/xdm.c has two empty static functions, sxml_node_item_retain_tree/_release_tree; packet fills them with sxml_tree_retain/sxml_tree_release (a two-line hand-off; no node item exists before 1.13).
sxml_error_record_report fills an error record from a sxml_static_error (err namespace), for every packet's static errors.
